verdict.rationale: Kimi Code ships an official terminal CLI, but the docs describe it only as an interactive chat session (start with `kimi`, then `/login`), with ACP used for editor integration. Nothing documents a non-interactive or print mode, scripted invocation, or CI usage. The OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API is a separate model-access building block, not a way to run the product itself headlessly, so none of this is credited toward the story.
